title: Implement proper Form/Group rendering to match golden files
Create minimal TUI framework (Bubble Tea-like)

title: Implement Note field
description: Read-only informational display with optional Next button. (Phase 3.5)

title: Implement core abstractions (Field, Accessor, Selector, Eval)
description: Create Field interface with init/update/view/run_accessible methods. Implement Accessor pattern for value storage. Build generic Selector for navigation. Create Eval system with binding hashing. (Phase 1.2)

title: Setup golden file test infrastructure
description: Create test harness that runs Go tests and captures golden outputs. Establish comparison utilities for ANSI sequences. Set up pseudo-terminal (pty) testing environment. (Phase 1.1)

title: Implement accessibility mode
description: Add detection via environment variable or explicit flag. Create direct IO prompting functions for each field type. Implement run_accessible method on all fields. (Phase 4.4)

title: Implement Select field
description: Single option selection from list with filtering, inline mode, option display with selected indicator, and dynamic options via OptionsFunc. (Phase 3.1)

title: Implement basic styling engine (Lipgloss-like)
description: Create Style class with color, border, padding, margin, alignment. Implement adaptive colors for terminal detection. Build rendering pipeline for hierarchical styles. (Phase 1.4)

title: Implement basic form navigation
description: Create simple form with single group. Implement next/previous field navigation. Handle submit/abort. (Phase 2.3)

title: Implement Confirm field
description: Yes/No toggle with custom labels and simple keyboard navigation. (Phase 3.3)

title: Implement validation system
description: Create Validate callbacks with error display. Build built-in validators: not empty, min/max length, one-of. (Phase 2.2)

title: Implement theming system
description: Create hierarchical theme structure (form, group, field, focused/blurred). Implement built-in themes: Charm, Dracula, Base16, Catppuccin, Default. Add theme propagation and override rules. (Phase 4.1)

title: Implement layouts system
description: Create Layout interface with View(Form) and GroupWidth methods. Implement built-in layouts: Default (paged), Stack, Columns, Grid. Integrate with viewport for scrolling. (Phase 4.2)

title: Implement Text field
description: Multi-line text area with external editor support (via hx), character limit with counter. (Phase 3.4)

title: Fix command handling (Init returns Cmd, Update expects Msg)

description: Install Go dependencies, run Go test suite, capture reference outputs for all test scenarios. Store in testdata/go/ directory. Create comparison utilities for ANSI sequences.

title: Implement Input field with all features
